item.title: Kingpin: How One Hacker Took Over the Billion-Dollar Cybercrime Underground
item.description: There’s a line in society. On one side of it you’re a “good guy” and on the other side you aren’t anymore. At least that’s what we’re told growing up. Kevin Poulsen, is a complex figure who bobs and weaves back and forth across the line. He genuinely seems to not care about the line, and sometimes to not be able to see it all. For him, the important thing is doing what he loves, hacking. The art of making things do more than they were designed. It is a sort of malicious compliance of technology.
